chain.title: Sage Seeds
chain.desc: Break grass and tall grass; a global loot modifier scatters sage seeds among the wheat seeds. The first Hexerei item anyone finds.

chain.title: Animal Fat
chain.desc: Gather Animal Fat through the mod's supported drops and recipes. Keep it for tallow processing and candle making rather than treating it as ordinary food.

chain.title: Mahogany
chain.desc: Mahogany trees grow in dark, damp biomes alongside Willow and Witch Hazel. Mahogany is the witch's timber and every device below is framed in it.

chain.title: Mixing Cauldron
chain.desc: Set up the Mixing Cauldron and provide the liquid, heat and ingredients shown by the chosen recipe. Check the recipe page when a mixture stalls; not every mixture uses the same liquid or conditions.

chain.title: Drying Rack
chain.desc: Hang supported herbs and bundles on the Drying Rack and give them time to finish. Store fresh and dried ingredients separately so you can find the form each recipe needs.

chain.title: Nature Coven
chain.desc: Find a Nature Coven and explore its rooms for herbs and witchcraft supplies. Bring home samples you can use to expand your own garden and workroom.

chain.title: Mandrake Root
chain.desc: Harvest a mature Mandrake or obtain its root from the supported loot sources. Prepare for the plant's reaction when harvested and reserve roots for broom and amulet recipes.

chain.title: Broom Netherite Tip
chain.desc: Prepare the Netherite Broom Tip and inspect its listed benefits before fitting it. Choose a tip for the journey you plan rather than assuming every upgrade serves the same purpose.

chain.title: Dark Coven
chain.desc: The Nature Coven's opposite number. chests/dark_coven_basic is the only worldgen source of Animal Fat, Bottles of Blood and a ready-made Blood Sigil, and its coffer room is stocked with gold.

chain.title: Sage
chain.desc: Grow Sage from the seeds found while gathering plants. Split your harvest between fresh ingredients, dried herbs and bundles so one recipe does not consume the whole garden.

chain.title: Book of Shadows
chain.desc: Make the Book of Shadows and use its recipe pages while arranging your workroom. The herb garden, cauldron, candles and broom projects can develop as separate branches.

chain.title: Altar
chain.desc: Mahogany Planks and a Mahogany Slab. Rest the Book of Shadows on it to read hands-free and to mark the corner of your workroom.

chain.title: Pestle and Mortar
chain.desc: Prepare the Pestle and Mortar for the grinding and blending recipes in the Book of Shadows. Start with a mixture you need for another project so the new tool immediately earns its place.

chain.title: Herb Jar
chain.desc: Organise the herbs you use most often in labelled or visibly arranged Herb Jars. A working ingredient shelf makes long cauldron recipes much easier to prepare.

chain.title: Infused Fabric
chain.desc: Make Infused Fabric in the Mixing Cauldron. Set some aside for equipment and broom components before turning the entire batch into building blocks.

chain.title: Small Satchel
chain.desc: A Gold Nugget, Leather and String in the cauldron. Upgrade it into the medium and large satchels, then into the Ender Satchel.

chain.title: Coffer
chain.desc: Mahogany Planks and Gold in the cauldron. A lockable strongbox, and the block the coven chests in worldgen are stocked from.

chain.title: Dipper
chain.desc: Prepare tallow in the cauldron and set up the Candle Dipper with the required string. Follow the dipping steps to finish candles, then experiment with the supported candle additions.

chain.title: Bottle of Blood
chain.desc: Bottle blood from a Mixing Cauldron containing the correct fluid. Reserve bottles for recipes such as brooms; ordinary water bottles will not substitute for them.

chain.title: Crow Flute
chain.desc: Tame a crow and use the Crow Flute to select and direct it. Test one simple gathering or transport order before assigning a complicated job around your base.

chain.title: Crow Ankh Amulet
chain.desc: Prepare the Ankh Amulet and fit it to a crow as described in the book. Check the protection it provides before sending an important helper into a dangerous area.

chain.title: Broom Brush
chain.desc: Prepare the wet brush mixture, then finish the brush on the Drying Rack. Fit it to a compatible broom and compare its flight behaviour before making more upgrades.

chain.title: Blood Sigil
chain.desc: Make the Blood Sigil through the cauldron recipe and follow the Book of Shadows for its placement and use. Test the setup deliberately instead of assuming a decorative marker performs the whole process.

chain.title: Dried Sage
chain.desc: Sage left on the Drying Rack. Dried herbs are the currency of the cauldron.

chain.title: Dried Sage Bundle
chain.desc: Tie Sage with String, then dry the bundle. Lit, a sage bundle smoulders and cleanses the area around it.

chain.title: Witch's Hat
chain.desc: Infused Fabric shaped into the pointed hat. The Robe, Boots and the rest of the set come from the same cloth.

chain.title: Mahogany Broom
chain.desc: Make a Mahogany Broom with the cauldron recipe and inspect its equipment slots. Test take-off and landing in open space before flying over hazards or carrying valuable supplies.

chain.title: Broom Seat
chain.desc: Combine your fabric and storage work into a Broom Seat. Fit it to the broom and check its passenger and storage behaviour during a short, safe flight.

chain.title: Sage Burning Plate
chain.desc: Place a prepared sage bundle on the burning plate and use it as the book describes. Keep replacement bundles nearby when the cleansing effect is part of your workshop routine.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Herb garden, drying, cauldron, candles, crow helpers, exploration and broom equipment.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
